summary: Split standard_fleet god module into focused submodules

delivery.outcome: src/koru/standard_fleet.py (574 lines, 6 classes, 25 functions) becomes the koru.standard_fleet package split by responsibility: models, git_observation, discovery, scan, emission and reporting submodules behind an unchanged public facade. Behavior is unchanged: the existing tests/test_standard_fleet.py and tests/test_cli_fleet.py pass without modification and every name in the former module __all__ remains importable from koru.standard_fleet.
nonGoals: Changing the scanner's selection, exclusion or emission behavior
Altering the CLI surface in src/koru/cli_fleet.py
Renaming or removing any public name

architecture.decision: Convert the module to a package whose submodules own one responsibility each and re-export the previous public surface from __init__.py so cli_fleet.py and the monkeypatch target koru.standard_fleet.scan_standard_fleet keep working.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the previous single-module implementation is restored verbatim.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "import koru.standard_fleet as m; assert not [n for n in m.__all__ if not hasattr(m, n)]"
validation.evidence: Every former public name resolves through the package facade.
Focused scanner and CLI fleet suites pass unmodified.

commands: ruff check src/koru/standard_fleet && ruff format --check src/koru/standard_fleet
validation.evidence: Lint and format pass on the new package.
Governance gate passes with zero errors.
